description: This file defines a React functional component 'Profile' for managing user profiles. It includes state management, side effects for data fetching, form handling, and UI rendering related to user profile editing, role selection, and KPI display. It interacts with external APIs and libraries such as Supabase, custom API functions, and RPC calls.
